tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Is the heating on?"

B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue tile is a phrasal verb (turn on). Put it in the past or add -s. Watch out: with it, them or her, the little word goes to the end: I turned it on, not I turned on it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.
